heading: Authorization of appropriations; reservations

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this part—

children.text: $200,741,000 for each of fiscal years 2017 and 2018; and
$220,741,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 and 2020.

tree.heading: Reservations
tree.text: From the amounts appropriated under subsection (a) for a fiscal year, the Secretary shall—

children.text: reserve $5,000,000 to carry out activities authorized under subpart 3; and
from the amounts remaining after the reservation under paragraph (1)—
carry out activities authorized under subpart 1 using—
36 percent of such remainder for each of fiscal years 2017 and 2018; and
42 percent of such remainder for each of fiscal years 2019 and 2020;
carry out activities authorized under subpart 2 using—
36 percent of such remainder for each of fiscal years 2017 and 2018; and
32 percent of such remainder for each of fiscal years 2019 and 2020; and
to carry out activities authorized under subpart 4— 1
28 percent of such remainder for each of fiscal years 2017 and 2018; and
26 percent of such remainder for each of fiscal years 2019 and 2020.
